model.title: Institutional infrastructure, not a token launch
model.body: ReserveChain is building the documentation, verification and reconciliation layer that would need to exist before an industrial-metal reserve could credibly be represented on-chain. Evidence first; tokens only if and when the structure supports them.

items.p: An asset registry, per-unit Digital Asset Passports, reserve reconciliation and a configurable ERC-20 infrastructure.
Not a presale, an allocation, a price, or an offer to buy or sell any token or asset.
Asset owners and originators, institutional counterparties, and industrial buyers of copper powder and nickel wire.

workflow.title: From documented lot to intended redemption
workflow.body: Six stages, each gated on evidence being supplied and approved before the next begins.

items.p: Lots recorded at container and coil level with certificates, ownership, custody and valuation records.
Laboratory analysis, inspection and documentary review by parties independent of ReserveChain.
Verified lots held under a documented custody agreement with warehouse receipts and insurance.
Physical inventory reconciled against any issued supply, traceable to approved source documents.
Configurable ERC-20 built and tested on testnet; mainnet only after audit and written authorization.
Eligible holders could request delivery of identified units, subject to screening and logistics.

how-it-works.title: How ReserveChain Is Intended to Work
how-it-works.intro: An outline of the proposed end-to-end model, from documenting an industrial-metal lot through to a planned tokenized representation and physical redemption.

s.p: Industrial-metal lots are intended to be recorded in the asset registry at container and coil level, together with their certificates, ownership records, custody arrangements and valuation history. Registration is a documentation step only and does not create an offering of any kind.

Laboratory analysis, physical inspection and documentary review are intended to be carried out by parties independent of ReserveChain before any asset record is published as verified. Until that evidence has been supplied and approved, records remain marked as pending verification.

Verified lots are intended to be held under a documented custody arrangement, evidenced by warehouse receipts and covered by insurance. The custody structure is currently in development and no custody relationship is presented as operational.

A reconciliation process is planned between the physical inventory recorded in the registry and any tokens that may be issued in future, so that any reported coverage can be traced back to approved source documents rather than asserted.

A configurable ERC-20 infrastructure is being built and tested on a public testnet. No token has been issued, no contract address is published, and deployment to Ethereum mainnet would take place only after written authorization and completion of an independent audit.

A redemption workflow is being built so that, if activated in future, eligible holders could request physical delivery of identified containers or coils, subject to eligibility screening, logistics, customs requirements and applicable law. The module is currently inactive.

verification.title: Asset Verification
verification.intro: The verification framework ReserveChain intends to apply to industrial-metal lots before any asset record is published as verified.

s.h: What verification is intended to cover
s.p: The intended scope of verification differs by program, but is expected to address composition, physical characteristics and identification in each case.
li: Chemical composition and purity determined by an accredited laboratory
Particle size distribution, morphology and density for copper powder
Wire diameter, tolerance, temper and tensile properties for nickel wire
Net weight, packaging integrity and seal condition
Batch, container and coil identifiers reconciled against supporting documentation

s.p: Verification is intended to be performed by laboratories and inspection bodies independent of ReserveChain. ReserveChain does not perform laboratory analysis, does not issue certificates of analysis, and does not express an opinion on the results of any third-party assessment.

Purity, weight, ownership, custody and reserve claims remain unpublished until supporting evidence has been received, reviewed and approved. Records without approved evidence are displayed as pending verification rather than populated with provisional figures.

No verification programme is presented as complete. Certificate data referenced elsewhere on this website is illustrative and remains subject to documentary verification, independent assessment and final approval.

custody.title: Custody Structure
custody.intro: The custody, storage and insurance arrangements ReserveChain intends to put in place for documented industrial-metal lots.

s.p: Verified lots are intended to be stored in third-party warehouse facilities under a documented custody agreement, with warehouse receipts issued at container and coil level so that each unit remains individually identifiable.
The registry is being built to hold the following custody evidence for each unit, each of which stays in a pending state until the underlying document is approved.
li: Custody agreement and counterparty identification
Warehouse receipt per container or coil
Storage location, conditions and handling requirements
Seal numbers and integrity check records
Insurance cover, insurer and policy period
Chain-of-custody events recorded over time

s.p: Custodied lots are intended to be held separately from the operating assets of any ReserveChain entity, so that inventory recorded in the registry can be reconciled independently of the issuer's own balance sheet.

No custodian, warehouse operator or insurer is currently confirmed, appointed or presented as engaged. Custody fields shown on asset pages remain marked pending until agreements are executed and supporting evidence is approved.

proof-of-reserves.title: Proof of Reserves
proof-of-reserves.intro: A reserve-reporting module is being built so that, once real data and an attestation are available, physical inventory and any issued tokens can be reconciled transparently.

s.h: What the dashboard is intended to show
s.p: The module has been built against the following intended reporting scope. None of these figures are currently published.
li: Token supply: issued, circulating, treasury-held, locked, burned and redeemed
Approved reserve value and the resulting coverage ratio
Valuation date and attestation date
Custody and insurance summary
Breakdown by program, metal, lot, batch, container and coil
Custodian reconciliation and exception reporting

s.p: Reserve reporting is intended to be derived from approved source records rather than entered manually. Where a discrepancy is detected between inventory, custodian records and on-chain supply, the system is designed to report the exception rather than adjust balances automatically.

ReserveChain does not describe reserve data as independently verified in the absence of an attestation from a qualified third party. No attestor has been appointed and no attestation has been obtained.

The Proof-of-Reserves module is built but inactive. No reserve figures, coverage ratios or attestations are published, and none will be published until source data, an appointed attestor and written authorization are in place.

industrial-metal-assets.title: Industrial Metal Assets
industrial-metal-assets.intro: ReserveChain's initial asset programs cover high-purity copper powder and nickel wire, documented and identified at individual unit level.

s.p: A high-purity copper powder program documented at container level, covering chemical composition, particle size distribution, morphology, apparent and tap density, oxygen and moisture content, packaging and seal condition. All specification values shown on this website are illustrative pending verification.

A high-purity nickel wire program documented at coil level, covering chemical composition, wire diameter and tolerance, coil length and weight, surface finish, temper and tensile properties. All specification values shown on this website are illustrative pending verification.

Both programs are modelled so that every physical unit — each container of powder, each coil of wire — carries its own identifier, documentation set and status. This is what makes unit-level reconciliation and, if ever activated, unit-level redemption possible.
The underlying data model is designed to be reusable for further industrial-metal programs and other real-world asset classes. No additional programs are announced or planned for a specific date.
No asset program is verified, tokenized or offered. Ownership, laboratory, custody, insurance and valuation records remain pending until documentary evidence is supplied and approved.

tokenization.title: Tokenization
tokenization.intro: The planned ERC-20 architecture, what is deliberately left unconfigured, and the conditions that would have to be met before anything is deployed to mainnet.

s.p: The planned primary token is an ERC-20 contract on Ethereum, built with OpenZeppelin components and administered through role-based access control with a multi-signature arrangement for privileged actions. The suite is currently developed and tested on a public testnet only.
The contract and supporting services are built so that the following remain configuration, not hard-coded assumptions. Each is unset pending approval.
li: Token name and symbol — pending authorization
Total and circulating supply — no tokens issued
Any ratio between tokens and physical units — not determined
Transfer restrictions and eligibility controls
Pause, mint and burn roles held under multi-signature control

s.p: Contracts are deployed and exercised on a public testnet for development and testing purposes. No contract address is published on this website, and any address circulating elsewhere should not be treated as authentic.

Token price, a supply figure derived from asset valuation, redemption thresholds, ownership or title rights attaching to a token, and any expectation of appreciation, liquidity or return are not defined, not implied and not to be inferred from anything on this website.

No token has been issued or offered. Deployment to Ethereum mainnet and any token generation event would take place only after an independent smart-contract audit, the finalization of the legal and corporate structure, and written authorization.

redemption.title: Redemption
redemption.intro: A physical-redemption workflow is being built so that, if it is ever activated, identified containers or coils could be released against tokens under controlled conditions.

s.p: The workflow has been implemented end to end and kept behind a feature flag. If activated, it is intended to run in the following order.
li: Wallet verification and eligibility re-check, including KYC, AML and sanctions screening
Jurisdiction check and confirmation of any applicable threshold
Selection of the specific lot, container or coil to be redeemed
Disclosure of fees, taxes, shipping, insurance, custody and packaging costs
Acceptance of redemption terms and electronic signature
Internal review with maker-checker approval
Token lock and burn, followed by custodian release and delivery tracking
Update of the registry, reserve reporting and supply records, with a full audit trail

s.p: Redemption would be available only to holders who pass eligibility screening at the time of the request, in jurisdictions where the transaction is permitted. Passing screening once would not create a continuing entitlement.

Industrial metals in commercial quantities carry handling, transport, customs and insurance requirements. Any redemption would be subject to those costs and to applicable dangerous-goods and export rules, which have not yet been determined.

The redemption module is inactive. No redemption right exists, none is offered, and activation would require the underlying legal, custody and token arrangements to be finalized and authorized in writing.

legal-structure.title: Legal & Asset-Holding Structure
legal-structure.intro: The corporate, asset-holding and regulatory arrangements intended to sit behind the platform, and their current status.

s.p: A Swiss corporate and issuance structure is in development. The issuing entity, its governance arrangements, its share capital and its regulatory position are not finalized, and no entity is presented on this website as the confirmed issuer.

The intended structure separates the entity holding or controlling the physical assets from the entity responsible for any future token issuance, so that inventory can be reconciled independently. The specific arrangements are subject to legal and tax review.

The legal classification of any future token has not been determined. Whether an instrument would be treated as a payment, utility or asset token, and the consequences of that classification, are matters for the final legal structure and applicable regulatory guidance.

ReserveChain does not hold, and does not claim to hold, any regulatory authorization, licence or registration. This website is not directed at residents of the European Union or European Economic Area and does not constitute marketing of a crypto-asset under MiCA.
Until the structure is finalized and definitive offering documentation exists, no offer, invitation or solicitation is made through this website in any jurisdiction.

about.title: About ReserveChain
about.intro: ReserveChain is developing institutional infrastructure intended to represent documented industrial-metal reserves as on-chain tokens, paired with transparent asset documentation.

s.p: A platform combining an industrial-metal asset registry, per-unit Digital Asset Passports, a configurable ERC-20 infrastructure, reserve reconciliation and a physical-redemption workflow, together with the portals and controls needed to operate them.
The project is positioned as institutional infrastructure for real-world assets. It is not a speculative crypto offering, a presale or a token launch, and it is not marketed as one.

Nothing on this website is presented as operational until it is supported by documentation and approved. Where data is not yet available, the platform shows a pending state rather than an illustrative figure that could be mistaken for verified information.
The project is in the development and pre-launch stage. The corporate structure, asset verification, custody arrangements, token classification and independent audit are all outstanding.

corporate-status.title: Corporate Development Status
corporate-status.intro: A plain statement of what has and has not been completed, so that the stage of the project is not left to inference.

s.p: The following are in progress and not finalized.
li: Swiss corporate and issuance structure
Token legal classification and regulatory position
Asset verification and laboratory documentation
Custody, warehouse and insurance arrangements
Proof-of-reserves methodology and appointment of an attestor
Independent smart-contract audit and penetration test

s.p: No token has been issued. No contract has been deployed to Ethereum mainnet. No offering documentation exists. No custodian, insurer, attestor or auditor has been appointed. No regulatory authorization has been obtained or applied for on the basis of a final structure.

A public website in three languages, an asset registry and Digital Asset Passport structure, an administrative console, a backend API, and a smart-contract suite exercised on a public testnet. Sensitive modules are built but remain inactive.
This page is intended to be updated as items move from in-development to completed, with supporting documentation published alongside each change.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.intro: The intended sequence of work. Dates are deliberately omitted because delivery depends on legal, verification and authorization steps that are outside the project's unilateral control.

s.p: Requirements, architecture, design system, public website in English, Spanish and Italian, waitlist and the underlying asset data model. Substantially in place.
Asset registry, Digital Asset Passports, backend API, administrative console, KYC and compliance case management, and a configurable ERC-20 suite tested on a public testnet. In progress.

Independent laboratory verification, custody and insurance arrangements, finalization of the Swiss corporate structure, token classification, and appointment of an attestor for reserve reporting. Dependent on owner decisions and third-party engagement.
Independent smart-contract audit and penetration test, remediation, and acceptance testing. This stage is a gate: nothing beyond it proceeds until it is complete.

Any mainnet deployment, token generation event, activation of purchase, proof-of-reserves publication or redemption would occur only after stage 4 is complete and written authorization has been given. No date is committed to for this stage.

governance.title: Governance
governance.intro: The controls intended to govern privileged actions across the platform, the treasury and the asset registry.

s.p: Operational, compliance, finance, treasury, content and audit responsibilities are separated by role. The platform is built so that no single account can both initiate and approve a sensitive action.

Sensitive actions — publication of asset claims, changes to token configuration, compliance decisions and treasury operations — are designed to require a second, independent approval before taking effect.
Privileged smart-contract roles are intended to be held by a multi-signature arrangement rather than an individual key. The signer set and threshold have not been established.

Administrative actions are recorded in an append-only, tamper-evident audit log capturing the actor, time, action, record, previous and new values, and the reason. The log cannot be edited or deleted through the interface.
These controls are implemented in the platform. The people, entities and signer arrangements that would operate them are not yet appointed.

s.p: It registers your interest so the project can contact you with updates. It does not constitute an investment, token purchase, asset reservation, price reservation, allocation of tokens or entitlement to participate in any future offering.

s.p: The figures shown are illustrative and drawn from preliminary documentation. They remain subject to documentary verification, independent assessment and final approval, and are labelled accordingly wherever they appear.

s.p: This website is not directed at residents of the European Union or European Economic Area, and nothing on it constitutes marketing of a crypto-asset under MiCA. Jurisdictional eligibility would be determined by the final legal structure.
No launch date is committed to. Activation depends on the finalization of the legal structure, asset verification, custody arrangements, an independent audit and written authorization.

asset-owner-enquiries.title: Asset-Owner Enquiries
asset-owner-enquiries.intro: For producers, traders and holders of documented industrial-metal inventory who want to understand the intended onboarding process.

s.p: Onboarding is designed as a documentation exercise first. Nothing is published about an asset until the supporting evidence has been reviewed and approved.
li: Initial enquiry and description of the inventory
Counterparty due diligence, including KYB and sanctions screening
Submission of ownership, title and provenance documentation
Independent laboratory analysis and physical inspection
Custody, warehousing and insurance arrangements
Registration in the asset registry with unit-level identifiers
Digital Asset Passport issuance for each documented unit

s.h: What is required from an asset owner
s.p: Clear evidence of ownership and title, access for independent inspection and sampling, complete batch and unit identification, and a willingness to place inventory under a documented custody arrangement.
No purchase, financing, valuation guarantee, tokenization commitment or listing is offered. Registry onboarding does not create any obligation on either side to proceed to tokenization.
Submit an enquiry through the project waitlist form, indicating an asset-owner or originator interest. No commercial terms are offered at this stage.

industrial-buyer-enquiries.intro: For industrial buyers with physical offtake requirements for high-purity copper powder or nickel wire.

s.p: Registering a physical offtake requirement so that it can be considered as the asset programs and custody arrangements develop. It is an enquiry route, not an order channel.
Material and specification required, indicative volumes and delivery frequency, destination and applicable import requirements, and any certification or traceability obligations your process imposes.

No inventory is offered for sale through this website, no price is quoted, and no availability, delivery window or capacity is committed. Any future supply would be subject to contract, verification and applicable law.
Submit an enquiry through the project waitlist form, indicating an industrial-buyer interest and the material concerned.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How personal data submitted through this website is handled during the development stage of the project.

s.p: The controller will be the ReserveChain issuing entity once the corporate structure is finalized. Until then, personal data submitted through this website is processed by the project team responsible for the development of the platform. This section will be updated with the definitive entity details.

Only the data you submit through the waitlist or an enquiry form: your name, email address, country, organization where given, the type of interest you indicate, and the consents you record. Technical data such as IP address and browser information may be processed for security and to operate the site.

To respond to your enquiry, to send project updates you have asked for, to maintain a record of the consents you gave, and to meet legal and record-keeping obligations. Your data is not used to make an offer of any financial instrument, because no such offer is made through this website.

No payment information, wallet address, private key or seed phrase is requested, collected or accepted through this website at this stage. Any request for such information purporting to come from ReserveChain should be treated as fraudulent.

Data is shared only with service providers that operate the website, its database and its email delivery, acting on instructions. Data may be disclosed where required by law. Data is not sold and is not shared for third-party marketing.

Enquiry and waitlist records are retained for as long as needed to respond to the enquiry and to evidence the consents given, and are then deleted or anonymised. Definitive retention periods will be set with the final legal structure.

Subject to applicable law, you may request access to your data, correction of inaccurate data, deletion, restriction of processing, portability, and withdrawal of consent at any time. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal.
Requests can be submitted through the contact route on this website. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority in your jurisdiction.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.intro: What is stored on your device when you use this website, and what is deliberately not stored.

s.p: This website is built to operate with essential storage only. Essential items are those needed to serve the site in your chosen language, to keep the multi-step waitlist form working, and to protect against abuse of the forms.
Your language selection between English, Spanish and Italian is reflected in the page address and may be stored so that navigation stays in the language you chose.

No analytics or marketing cookies are set without your consent, and no tracking takes place before consent is given. Where analytics is enabled in future, it will be presented through a consent control that distinguishes essential, analytics and marketing categories.
The platform is designed so that personal data is not placed in analytics events or in page addresses.
You can clear or block browser storage through your browser settings. Blocking essential storage may prevent forms on this website from working correctly.

These terms may be updated as the project develops, and the definitive version will be issued with the final corporate structure together with the governing law and jurisdiction that apply to it.

risk-disclosure.title: Risk Disclosure
risk-disclosure.intro: The principal risks associated with the project as described on this website. This is not an exhaustive list, and it is not a substitute for independent advice.

s.p: The project is in development. It may be delayed, materially changed, suspended or abandoned. There is no assurance that any token will be issued, that any platform module will be activated, or that the project will proceed at all.

The corporate structure, the legal classification of any future token and the applicable regulatory treatment are not determined. Regulatory developments may restrict, delay or prevent the project, or exclude participation from particular jurisdictions.

Asset information is illustrative and unverified. Independent analysis may not confirm the composition, quantity, quality, ownership or provenance of any lot, and documentation may prove incomplete or defective.
No custodian or insurer has been appointed. Physical assets are exposed to loss, damage, theft, deterioration, warehouse insolvency and gaps in insurance cover.

Smart contracts may contain defects. An independent audit has not been completed. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, and loss of a private key would result in permanent loss of access to any associated assets.
Industrial-metal prices fluctuate. No market, exchange listing, liquidity, price or ability to sell or redeem is offered, promised or implied. Any future instrument could be illiquid or lose value.

The project depends on third parties including laboratories, inspectors, custodians, insurers, auditors and service providers. Failure, insolvency or misconduct by any of them could materially affect the project.
Projects at this stage are targeted by impersonation and fraud. No token sale exists. Verify every communication against the Official Channels Directory before acting on it.
Any future participation, if it were ever offered, should be regarded as carrying the risk of total loss of the amount involved.

restricted-jurisdictions.title: Restricted Jurisdictions
restricted-jurisdictions.intro: Where this website is not directed, and how jurisdictional eligibility is intended to be handled.

s.h: European Union and European Economic Area
s.p: This website is not directed at residents of the European Union or the European Economic Area. Nothing on it constitutes marketing, advertising or solicitation in respect of a crypto-asset under MiCA, and the project does not hold any authorization under that regime.

The project does not intend to make any future offering available to persons or entities in jurisdictions subject to comprehensive sanctions, or to persons subject to applicable sanctions or asset-freezing measures.

A definitive list of permitted and restricted jurisdictions has not been established. It will be determined by the final legal structure and applicable regulatory advice, and published before any offering could take place.

The platform is built to support jurisdiction screening, country of residence, nationality and current-location checks, sanctions and politically-exposed-person screening, transfer restrictions and recordkeeping of eligibility decisions. These controls are implemented but inactive.

Any future eligibility rules must not be circumvented, including through the use of a nominee, an intermediary, a false declaration or technical means of concealing location. Attempts to do so would invalidate eligibility.
You are responsible for ensuring that accessing this website and any future participation would be lawful for you. If it would not be, you should not proceed.

anti-fraud.title: Anti-Fraud & Anti-Impersonation
anti-fraud.intro: How to recognise fraudulent communications that claim to represent ReserveChain, and what the project will never ask you to do.

s.p: No token has been issued and no token, presale, allocation, whitelist place or discount is offered or sold by ReserveChain. Any offer of these things is fraudulent, regardless of how convincing it appears.
Treat any of the following as conclusive evidence of fraud.
li: Ask for your seed phrase, private key or wallet password
Ask you to connect a wallet or approve a transaction
Ask you to send cryptocurrency or a payment of any kind
Publish or send you a contract address to buy a token
Offer guaranteed returns, allocations, bonuses or a countdown to a deadline
Contact you through an unofficial channel to request funds or personal documents

s.p: Fraudulent actors clone websites at similar domain names, create social accounts using the project name and branding, impersonate team members in direct messages, and circulate fabricated contract addresses, audit reports or partnership announcements.

Check the Official Channels Directory on this website before acting on any communication. Confirm the exact domain name. Treat any channel not listed there as unverified, including channels that use the project's name, logo or wording.

Do not send funds, do not connect a wallet, and do not share documents. Report the communication through the contact route on this website, and report it to the relevant authority in your jurisdiction. ReserveChain cannot recover funds sent to a fraudulent party.

official-channels.title: Official Channels Directory
official-channels.intro: The definitive list of channels operated by the project. Anything not listed here is not operated by ReserveChain.

s.p: This website is the project's primary channel. Confirm the domain name in your browser's address bar before submitting any information. Look-alike domains using different spellings or extensions are not operated by the project.

Official social media, messaging and community channels have not been established at this stage. Because none exist, any account, group or channel presenting itself as an official ReserveChain community is not genuine.

Project correspondence is sent only in response to an enquiry submitted through this website, and only from an address at the project's own domain. Messages from free email providers or look-alike domains are not from the project.

The project operates no payment channel, no wallet address for receiving funds, no exchange listing and no token sale channel of any kind. No such channel will be introduced through an unannounced message.
This directory is intended to be updated whenever a channel is established or retired. Treat this page, and not any third-party listing, as the reference.
